scenarios.normal_load: healthy route; ambiguity is rare, so checks have little legitimate benefit
scenarios.near_saturation: rho 0.95; extra checks consume scarce capacity
scenarios.sudden_degradation: capacity -50 % at 595 s until the end; unannounced drop (estimator detection lag)
scenarios.prolonged_fault: report S2: capacity -35 % for 20 minutes; Stage 05 found checks counterproductive
scenarios.status_check_bursts: 30 % lost confirmations (checks can resolve) plus exogenous A3 check demand at 25 % of capacity for 300 s on the shared route
scenarios.repay_feedback: every customer re-pays an ambiguous payment; capacity -35 % from 400 s
scenarios.lost_confirmation: RV-1: 30 % of confirmations lost and capacity -20 % (300-1200 s); checks can resolve
scenarios.route_recovery: capacity -35 % for 300 s, then a recovered route
scenarios.healthy_parallel_route: S2 with a healthy A1-C beside the degraded A1-B (route isolation and fairness)
scenarios.stale_telemetry: RV-1 with no telemetry delivered to AORTS for 300 s
scenarios.poisoned_telemetry: S2 with AORTS's own-traffic throughput reported x2 during the fault (unflagged)
scenarios.poisoned_telemetry_30: S2 with throughput reported x1.3 during the fault (unflagged)
scenarios.controller_outage: RV-1 with the controller unavailable for 300 s (Track B fallback, 2/route/decision)
